recommendation_summary: Act now: make the lead and the two qualified engineers a reviewer pool where any one can approve, auto-assign reviewers, set a response target with pickup by another pool member, take people on leave out of rotation, keep lead-only review for narrowly defined cases and track time from opened to approved. Optional: a short alignment session and drafting the CODEOWNERS file and a team agreement. Squads/chapters and Jira Align are deferred until the team grows to several teams, and quarterly workshops are put below the alignment session. Still open: which code host and tracker the team uses.
note: The fix is a small reviewer-pool change, but none of the four labeled record lines appear, so the label-based predicates fail.
